tests.name: isolated Chromium baseline/candidate comparison
tests.result: EXPECTED baseline defect captured; candidate passed

tests.name: replacement manifest exactness
tests.result: PASS: 2 exact baseline blocks and candidate replacements

evidence.capturedResults: Baseline rendered the mirrored result twice (2 cards) and candidate rendered it once (1 card); the actual-backend-shaped fixture also changed 2 to 1. Empty output remained one artifact while missing output remained absent. Distinct source, run, parent run/target, command, output, provenance, stable ID, timestamp, swapped identity, repeated invocation, ordering, and ambiguous no-identity fixtures passed candidate expectations.

limitations: The harness used isolated Chromium contexts and reset local storage per fixture; provider, device, backend API, and user storage traffic were not used.
The default comparison intentionally exits 1 because the baseline defect is expected; all 17 candidate fixtures passed with zero blocked-request or page-error violations.
No-ID records reconcile only when the event/evidence match is unambiguous and has at least two matching provenance dimensions; ambiguous repeats remain visible to avoid erasing genuine results.
--integrated is supported by the harness for post-merge verification of the current project module without a candidate overlay. No live product, documentation, or workbook files were edited.
